SELECT
    d.A2 AS district,
    ROUND((d.A13 - d.A12) * 100.0 / d.A12, 2) AS unemployment_rate_percentage_change
FROM district AS d
WHERE d.A12 IS NOT NULL
  AND d.A13 IS NOT NULL
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM account AS a
      JOIN loan AS l ON l.account_id = a.account_id
      WHERE a.district_id = d.district_id
        AND l.status = 'D'
  );

WITH loan_totals AS (
    SELECT account_id, SUM(amount) AS total_amount_borrowed
    FROM loan
    GROUP BY account_id
),
outside_counterparties AS (
    SELECT account_id, COUNT(DISTINCT counterparty_account) AS counterparty_count
    FROM (
        SELECT account_id, account AS counterparty_account
        FROM trans
        WHERE operation IN ('PREVOD Z UCTU', 'PREVOD NA UCET')
          AND bank IS NOT NULL
          AND account IS NOT NULL

        UNION ALL

        SELECT account AS account_id, trans.account_id AS counterparty_account
        FROM trans
        WHERE operation IN ('PREVOD Z UCTU', 'PREVOD NA UCET')
          AND bank IS NOT NULL
          AND account IS NOT NULL
    )
    GROUP BY account_id
),
households AS (
    SELECT
        a.account_id,
        a.date AS account_opening_date,
        lt.total_amount_borrowed,
        COALESCE(oc.counterparty_count, 0) AS counterparty_count,
        home.A2 AS home_district,
        CAST(home.A4 AS INTEGER) AS district_population
    FROM account AS a
    JOIN loan_totals AS lt ON lt.account_id = a.account_id
    JOIN disp AS owner_disp
      ON owner_disp.account_id = a.account_id
     AND owner_disp.type = 'OWNER'
    JOIN client AS owner ON owner.client_id = owner_disp.client_id
    JOIN district AS home ON home.district_id = owner.district_id
    LEFT JOIN outside_counterparties AS oc ON oc.account_id = a.account_id
    WHERE a.district_id = (
        SELECT district_id
        FROM district
        WHERE A2 = 'Prachatice'
    )
)
SELECT
    account_id,
    account_opening_date,
    total_amount_borrowed,
    counterparty_count,
    home_district,
    district_population,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY district_population DESC) AS population_rank
FROM households
ORDER BY district_population DESC, account_id;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(p.OwnerUserId, p.OwnerDisplayName)) AS user_count
FROM votes AS v
JOIN posts AS p ON p.Id = v.PostId
WHERE v.BountyAmount >= 30
  AND v.CreationDate >= '2010-01-01'
  AND v.CreationDate < '2011-01-01';

SELECT ROUND(AVG(s.weight_kg)) AS average_weight_kg
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN alignment AS a ON a.id = s.alignment_id
JOIN colour AS c ON c.id = s.skin_colour_id
WHERE a.alignment = 'Bad'
  AND c.colour = 'Green'
  AND s.weight_kg IS NOT NULL
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM hero_power AS hp
      JOIN superpower AS p ON p.id = hp.power_id
      WHERE hp.hero_id = s.id
        AND p.power_name = 'Flight'
  );

WITH eligible AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM schools
    WHERE County IN ('Amador', 'Madera')
      AND DOCType IN (
          'Unified School District',
          'Elementary School District',
          'High School District',
          'County Office of Education (COE)'
      )
),
admin_rows AS (
    SELECT CDSCode, District, AdmFName1 AS first_name FROM eligible
    UNION ALL
    SELECT CDSCode, District, AdmFName2 FROM eligible
    UNION ALL
    SELECT CDSCode, District, AdmFName3 FROM eligible
),
totals AS (
    SELECT first_name, COUNT(DISTINCT CDSCode) AS school_count
    FROM admin_rows
    WHERE first_name IS NOT NULL
      AND TRIM(first_name) <> ''
    GROUP BY first_name
),
top_names AS (
    SELECT first_name
    FROM totals
    ORDER BY school_count DESC, first_name ASC
    LIMIT 2
),
districts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT District
    FROM eligible
)
SELECT
    d.District AS district_name,
    n.first_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
        WHEN a.first_name = n.first_name THEN a.CDSCode
    END) AS school_count
FROM districts AS d
CROSS JOIN top_names AS n
LEFT JOIN admin_rows AS a
    ON a.District = d.District
   AND a.first_name = n.first_name
GROUP BY d.District, n.first_name
ORDER BY d.District, n.first_name;

SELECT DISTINCT name
FROM cards
WHERE isPromo = 1
  AND frameVersion = (
      SELECT MAX(CAST(frameVersion AS INTEGER))
      FROM cards
      WHERE frameVersion GLOB '[0-9]*'
  )
  AND layout <> 'normal';

SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 'Hospital'
        WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 'Outpatient clinic'
    END AS care_setting,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ID) AS patient_count
FROM Patient
WHERE Diagnosis = 'SLE'
  AND Admission IN ('+', '-')
  AND ID IN (
      SELECT ID
      FROM Laboratory
      WHERE CASE
          WHEN "U-PRO" GLOB '[0-9]*' THEN CAST("U-PRO" AS INTEGER) >= 30
          WHEN "U-PRO" LIKE '+%' THEN CAST(substr("U-PRO", instr("U-PRO", '(') + 1) AS INTEGER) >= 30
          WHEN "U-PRO" LIKE '>=%' THEN CAST(substr("U-PRO", 3) AS INTEGER) >= 30
          ELSE 0
      END
  )
GROUP BY Admission;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS school_count
FROM schools AS s
JOIN frpm AS f
  ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
LEFT JOIN satscores AS sat
  ON sat.cds = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.School IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(s.School) <> ''
  AND s.StatusType = 'Active'
  AND CAST(f."Enrollment (K-12)" AS REAL) > 500
  AND CAST(
        CASE
          WHEN INSTR(s.GSserved, '-') > 0
            THEN SUBSTR(s.GSserved, INSTR(s.GSserved, '-') + 1)
          ELSE s.GSserved
        END AS INTEGER
      ) <= 8
  AND CAST(
        CASE
          WHEN INSTR(s.GSserved, '-') > 0
            THEN SUBSTR(s.GSserved, 1, INSTR(s.GSserved, '-') - 1)
          ELSE s.GSserved
        END AS INTEGER
      ) BETWEEN 1 AND 12
  AND (sat.cds IS NULL OR sat.NumTstTakr = 0);

WITH district_crimes AS (
    SELECT
        d.district_id,
        d.A2 AS district_name,
        d.A3 AS region_name,
        CAST(d.A4 AS INTEGER) AS inhabitants,
        COUNT(t.trans_id) AS crime_count
    FROM district AS d
    LEFT JOIN account AS a
        ON a.district_id = d.district_id
    LEFT JOIN trans AS t
        ON t.account_id = a.account_id
       AND t.date >= '1996-01-01'
       AND t.date < '1997-01-01'
    GROUP BY d.district_id, d.A2, d.A3, d.A4
),
ranked_central_boh AS (
    SELECT
        district_id,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            ORDER BY inhabitants DESC, lower(district_name) COLLATE NOCASE ASC
        ) AS population_rank
    FROM district_crimes
    WHERE region_name = 'central Bohemia'
),
top_three AS (
    SELECT
        dc.district_id,
        dc.district_name,
        dc.crime_count,
        rb.population_rank
    FROM district_crimes AS dc
    JOIN ranked_central_boh AS rb
      ON rb.district_id = dc.district_id
    WHERE rb.population_rank <= 3
),
averages AS (
    SELECT
        AVG(crime_count) AS overall_average
    FROM district_crimes
)
SELECT
    t.district_name,
    t.crime_count,
    ROUND(AVG(t.crime_count) OVER (), 2) AS three_district_average,
    ROUND(a.overall_average, 2) AS overall_average,
    ROUND(AVG(t.crime_count) OVER () - a.overall_average, 2) AS difference
FROM top_three AS t
CROSS JOIN averages AS a
ORDER BY t.population_rank;

SELECT
    f.`County Name` AS county_name,
    SUM(COALESCE(sa.NumTstTakr, 0)) AS total_sat_test_takers
FROM frpm AS f
JOIN schools AS s
    ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
LEFT JOIN satscores AS sa
    ON sa.cds = s.CDSCode
WHERE f.`NSLP Provision Status` = 'Provision 2'
  AND s.Magnet = 1
  AND s.State = 'CA'
GROUP BY f.`County Name`;
